events.summary: Avalanche bombs the No. 1 Reactor and claims responsibility, as President Shinra announces.
events.quote: Today the No. 1 Reactor was bombed. The terrorist group Avalanche has claimed responsibility for the bombing.

events.summary: Tidus recalls how Sin attacked Zanarkand and he woke up in Spira.
events.quote: When Sin attacked Zanarkand that day, I woke up in Spira.

events.summary: Tidus realizes there is no way back home to Zanarkand.
events.quote: He knew there was no way back home, back to Zanarkand.

events.summary: Seymour is sent by Yuna, warning that Spira's sorrow will prevail.
events.quote: So it is you, after all, who will send me.

events.summary: The Crystal Brave detains those allied with the Scions and takes control of the Rising Stones.
events.quote: The Rising Stones is also under our control.

events.summary: Moren recalls the Flood of Light, which left a luminous wasteland.
events.quote: We called this calamity the 'Flood of Light.'

events.summary: Locke finds the Phoenix that turned itself to stone.
events.quote: Legend has it that the Phoenix turned itself to stone ages ago... It seems the story was true.

events.summary: Gaius reveals the Ascian used him to restore his god.
events.quote: The Ascian used me, as he used so many others-all to further the restoration of his wretched god.

events.summary: The Crystarium guard deploys to answer Holminster's plea for aid.
events.quote: the guard has deployed in force in answer to Holminster's plea for aid.

events.summary: Kefka sits in his tower with the power of the Warring Triad, practically a god.
events.quote: Kefka's practically a god now, sitting up in that tower of his with the power of the Warring Triad at his command...

events.summary: Sephiroth learns his mother's name is Jenova.
events.quote: My mother's name is Jenova... 'The Jenova Project'... is this just a coincidence?

events.summary: Moenbryda comes to understand Louisoix's sacrificial choice.
events.quote: Master Louisoix... I understand now... the choice you made...

events.summary: Kuja encounters Alexander, whom he had awaited.
events.quote: Alexander, I've been waiting for you.
